# 📘 Rules half

Licensing, demerit points, right-of-way, stopping, parking, safe driving and more.

On the real test this is **20 questions**, and you need **16 right** to pass this half. This bank has **308** questions for it.

## Question types (every type gets equal weight: 60 each)
- **Exact numbers**: Metres, points, days, dollars, km/h, alcohol
- **Right-of-way**: Who goes first
- **Word traps**: NOT / EXCEPT / ALWAYS / NEVER / FIRST
- **Best action**: What to do in a situation
- **Laws & consequences**: What's required, and what happens if you don't
